required_preparation: one maintained weapon or basic defensive position
loss_limit: no permanent loss from ordinary failure
recovery_target: return to normal work within 1 day
anti_dominance_rule: no specialized loadout gains more than 5%p over a general loadout across all four encounters

pressure_or_reward_shape: site strength 2–5 with first elite and first boss
required_preparation: role-matched weapon or position plus first aid and reserve supplies
success_target: standard win 65–80%; elite 45–65%; boss first contact 25–45% and prepared 55–70%
recovery_target: return to normal readiness within 3 days after a prepared win
anti_dominance_rule: one answer cannot remove both elite and boss preparation costs

required_preparation: trained combatant pair plus ammunition or shield reserve
loss_limit: severe injury 10–20% at standard threat; boss 30–50%
recovery_target: recover equipment and personnel within 5 days
anti_dominance_rule: damage specialization must lose at least 10%p or equivalent cost outside its target encounter

pressure_or_reward_shape: site strength 4–7 with multi-role objective pressure
required_preparation: formation equipment medical stock and either fixed defense or mobility
recovery_target: restore the depleted strategic reserve within 7 days
anti_dominance_rule: one formation cannot cover control damage and mobility without an extra hand or logistics cost

pressure_or_reward_shape: site strength 5–8 with sustained supply pressure
required_preparation: maintained armour shield or ranged supply chain plus treatment capacity
loss_limit: severe injury 20–35%; failed boss can force retreat
anti_dominance_rule: high durability equipment consumes repair material and worker time at the same tier

required_preparation: three-role squad and reserve ammunition medicine and replacement kit
loss_limit: severe injury 20–35%; one major supply class may exhaust
anti_dominance_rule: no weapon family remains within 5%p of the best result in more than half of all tier-6-or-higher encounters

pressure_or_reward_shape: site strength 7–10 with elite and multi-front risk
required_preparation: combined internal defense and field response with medical queue capacity
loss_limit: severe injury 20–35%; failure creates a defense or relationship cost
recovery_target: restore the chosen defense posture within 15 days
anti_dominance_rule: field force and corridor fortification each leave one exposed approach or response delay

pressure_or_reward_shape: site strength 8–11 with late boss commitment
required_preparation: late-game loadout supply network and fallback defense sector
success_target: standard win 65–80%; boss first contact 25–45%; prepared 55–70%
loss_limit: boss severe injury 30–50%; failed attempt preserves a recoverable campaign state
anti_dominance_rule: boss preparation cannot be supplied solely by market purchase or one universal weapon set

required_preparation: portfolio-specific economy plus military and medical reserve
loss_limit: boss severe injury 30–50%; defeat may change campaign state without deleting the run
recovery_target: restore one composite crisis reserve before the next boss cycle
anti_dominance_rule: no build leads economy defense recovery and first-clear speed in every climate profile

pressure_or_reward_shape: individual history choice or automatic record
required_preparation: 0.5–3 adult-days of labor or an equivalent supply relationship or opportunity cost
success_target: choice gives a distinct legacy relationship or operating result
loss_limit: automatic record grants no free economic output; failed choice leaves a recoverable trace
recovery_target: 1–5 days for routine outcome; 5–15 days for legacy consequence
anti_dominance_rule: one response cannot be cheapest fastest and best for relationship legacy and material retention

pressure_or_reward_shape: service continuity safety and reputation collide
required_preparation: containment team facility access and 1–3 days of substitute stock
success_target: one response preserves service; one preserves safety; one preserves relationship or evidence
loss_limit: uncontained incident loses 3–8% of the current service portfolio capacity or creates a relationship debt
recovery_target: 3–10 days depending on containment and repair
anti_dominance_rule: all three responses must consume different scarce resources or create different later obligations

pressure_or_reward_shape: seasonal window converts staffing and stock into a limited gain
required_preparation: redirect 5–15% of current effective WU plus transport or storage capacity
success_target: benefit equals 1–3% of period output or a strategic item/route
loss_limit: ignored opportunity never removes essential survival capacity
recovery_target: 0–3 days; opportunity closes rather than punishes
anti_dominance_rule: opportunities cannot replace a portfolio's core source chain without its ordinary cost

pressure_or_reward_shape: weather ecology or supply shock tests a named weak axis
required_preparation: 5–15% of current effective WU plus stock or local facility preparation
success_target: prepared response preserves the primary network at reduced output
loss_limit: unprepared loss consumes 3–8% of period output or 1–3 critical stock days
anti_dominance_rule: one portfolio cannot nullify every seasonal pressure through a single facility or item

required_preparation: 1–3% of period production in exact cargo plus delivery capacity
success_target: regular reward returns 10–20% operating margin after cargo and transport
loss_limit: missed deadline loses cargo opportunity and relationship progress
anti_dominance_rule: no contract can fund its own cargo through immediate resale or duplicate delivery

pressure_or_reward_shape: urgent material personnel or escort commitment
required_preparation: 3–8% of period production or equivalent medical/security capacity
success_target: crisis reward buys a later route support or relationship advantage rather than free stock
loss_limit: failed crisis leaves relationship debt and a localized external pressure
recovery_target: 5–15 days depending on the chosen route
anti_dominance_rule: crisis contract cannot be the cheapest answer to every medical defense and supply shortage

required_preparation: 5–15% of period production or a unique item/worker commitment
success_target: strategic reward creates a route capability with a matching duty or maintenance burden
loss_limit: refusal preserves internal capital but closes the route for a defined period
recovery_target: 2–4 normal completions or one season before full return
anti_dominance_rule: strategic route cannot provide rare asset income without a physical cargo duty or reciprocal exposure

pressure_or_reward_shape: service capacity deadline and cultural fit compete
required_preparation: one room/service slot and request-specific stock for the deadline
success_target: successful request improves repeat value relationship or route access
loss_limit: failed request loses the reserved slot and produces a trust or inventory consequence
recovery_target: 1–7 days for ordinary request; 5–15 days for high-value guest
anti_dominance_rule: accepting every request must exceed a finite room worker or inventory limit

pressure_or_reward_shape: culture cohesion competes with daily operation
required_preparation: 1–5% of period effective WU plus prepared food space and participation capacity
success_target: scaled celebration improves cohesion with a matching supply and work cost
loss_limit: skipping preserves labor but creates a remembered relationship or integration cost
anti_dominance_rule: festival rewards do not stack into a universal relationship farm and each culture requires different preparation

pressure_or_reward_shape: ongoing accommodation competes for food space time and etiquette
required_preparation: recurring supply or room allocation plus participation time
success_target: accommodation reduces a named integration or relationship pressure
loss_limit: refusal preserves one resource while increasing a defined future pressure
recovery_target: one season or a negotiated integration period
anti_dominance_rule: one universal room item or meal cannot satisfy every culture without capacity or quality tradeoff
